notes: All nine runs 5/5 with simulator truth (45/45 trials). Four transient retries (timeouts/5xx) were absorbed without stopping a run.

Each controller was also replayed offline over five trials on all three seeds: 27/27 complete, own-seed replays reproduce the live action counts; no latent seed-dependent failure like the C-version P2/8675 controller.
The elbow-limit case rejected a first draft in three runs (2026 r2, 2026 r3, 8675 r3); the model rewrote the controller each time.

Two controllers remain slow (2026 r3 1.51x, 8675 r1 1.36x). Their two-link ratios (1.09, 1.30) are within the limit, but their elbow-case action ratios (1.46, 1.45) are the highest; the elbow-case ratio tracks the live ratio more closely than the two-link ratio in this batch (see summary). This is an observation, not a gate change.
